author: Yffe
content: SHIPPED — crates.io FFI boundary modules, L1-enforced (§9). Surface: a bodyless fn + #[boundary("crate::path")] (parse_attribute generalizes parse_slag; the ;-body is GATED on boundary.is_some() — a bodyless fn without #[boundary] is a parse ERROR, OQ-2). FnItem.body is now Option<Block>; the ripple across ~10 body-consumers handles None as a structured error/safe skip (no panic, no false pass). thermite-lower lower_boundary_fn_l1: req-check -> foreign call -> ens-check (foreign body NOT lowered/verified). forge gate_fn routes boundary fns to BoundaryL1 EARLY -> Certificate::boundary_l1 (Level L1, boundary:true, boundary_target, NOT L3); §7.1 triage (a/b/c) still applies (rule d maximal-fx exempt — foreign effects trusted by fiat). oracle_subset = (item,level,effects,slag,boundary). Loop: doc-author -> builder -> critic NO DIVERGENCE: boundary-never-L3 proven live (a lying contract -> L1, verus never spawned); None-ripple sound (every consumer audited); parse gate robust; triage applies (vacuous boundary -> EnsIsTrivial); wrapper not a no-op; golden deserializes. Commit 74a2b91. workspace 312 tests, clippy/fmt clean, skill budget 2560/6000. TCB-enumeration hook for #15; #17 reads the boundary flag. Not pushed.
